warning.titlePre: Range Rover Evoque D180 Timing Chain & EGR Wear
paragraphs: Range Rover Evoque D180 engines - the Ingenium diesel, across both L538 and L551 generations - commonly show timing chain tensioner wear, oil dilution from DPF regeneration, and EGR cooler leaks. We replace the timing chain, injector seals, and EGR components as standard on every D180 rebuild.

*include_in_hero_hook: yes, for Ingenium diesel (AJ200D/AJ150D). Source: established Ingenium diesel family pattern (Discovery Sport/Evoque platform, per G-BRF). This known issue applies to the D180 and the broader Ingenium diesel range.*
